scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.serve: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run start -w backend" "npm run preview -w frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @toolbox/shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
